people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

translations.web: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.
translations.bsb: Manasseh will have one portion bordering the territory of Naphtali from east to west.
translations.kjv: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.
